arStrings.szText: Flesh can only bear so much. At our last vision, our bodies surrender. The ceremony for our passing is called the Rhysis Nematou. The Severing of the Thread.
I am the last of our year to be severed…save Athrpa, of course.
Don’t have the vision until I return. I will set all right with the Eye.

Dear heart, my life has been full. I have walked many paths, lived many lives through the visions. I wish you could set aside your stubbornness and taste this same fulfillment. Do not dig forever in the earth when you could lift your eyes to the stars.
